message.orevault.arrived.vault: Your team's Vault. The portal ahead takes you home.
message.orevault.arrived.vault_blocked: Your team's Vault. The way home is blocked: clear the portal three blocks south.
message.orevault.sent_home.disbanded: This Vault's team has disbanded, so you were sent back to where you entered.
message.orevault.sent_home.not_their_tea: You are no longer in this Vault's team, so you were sent back to where you entered.
message.orevault.vault_damaged: This Vault's save is damaged, so it cannot be opened. The server log names the file for an admin.
message.orevault.vault_layout_archive_fa: This Vault is from an older layout and could not be moved aside. Ask an operator to check the server log.
message.orevault.vault_layout_archived: Your team's Vault was made with an older layout and has been archived. Go through the portal again for a new one.
orevault.configuration.debug.enable_debu: Turns on the debug subcommands of /orevault for operators. Takes effect on save, with no relog.
orevault.configuration.debug.tooltip: Playtest tools. This section is removed before 1.0.
orevault.configuration.ore_classificatio: Entries of the form modid:block_id=common, uncommon or rare, each for a block in the #c:ores tag. A bad entry is skipped with a warning in the server log. Takes effect on the next world load.
How ores found in the modpack are given their rarity.
orevault.configuration.resonance.curve_d: Divides the Resonance needed for every level by this number: 2.0 halves it and 0.5 doubles it, and the curve keeps its shape. Takes effect on the next world load.
orevault.configuration.resonance.target_: Target hours of play to reach Resonance level 30. Takes effect on the next world load.
orevault.configuration.resonance.tooltip: How much Resonance each level needs.
